description: "Review and update all project documentation to reflect the current project state."
name: "docs"
agent: "agent"
---
If the /docs/ folder does not exist in the root folder, create it and move all documentation files from the root folder to /docs/, except for AGENTS.md and MASTER-PROMPT.md which must remain in root. Then review the current state of the project by examining code, git history, issues, and the conversation so far. Update all project documentation files in the /docs/ folder to reflect the current status, progress, and state of the project. Update PROJECT-ONBOARDING.md, BUGS.md, and VERSIONS.md as needed. Do NOT modify AGENTS.md or MASTER-PROMPT.md. Only update or create docs that track the actual project state.
